description: B holds 20 rows (IDs 1-20). For a table-type, a dynaset and a snapshot over B and each value [Long 0 ;; Long 50 ;; Long 100 ;; Double 37.5 ;; Double 99.99 ;; Double 100.5 ;; Long -1 ;; Long 101 ;; "50" ;; Null ;; Empty]: (a) a fresh recordset with the value assigned to PercentPosition at once; read BOF, EOF, PercentPosition, AbsolutePosition (not table-type), ID and RecordCount; (b) one recordset after MoveLast with RecordCount read, assigning each value in turn and reading the same. Asks how an assigned percentage maps to a row, its rounding and out-of-range refusals, and how the unpopulated and populated states differ. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
